name: Achiri memory subsystem — per-user conversation history with JSONL store
goal: Enable persistent memory for Achiri. Implement a per-user conversation history store (JSONL on local, Supabase on cloud). Wire history loading/saving into AchiriConversationHandler.chat(). Update config.json memory_enabled: true. Gate: each conversation must continue naturally from prior context.
rationale: Voice validation passed 10/10 (Sprint 113). config.json memory_sprint='112+' signals this sprint is authorized. Phase 2A gate Apr 11. Memory is the key differentiator for Achiri vs generic chatbots. JSONL store is lowest-complexity option that works now — Supabase migration can follow.

tasks.title: AchiriMemoryStore — JSONL-based per-user history
tasks.description:
Create agents/achiri/memory-store.ts

EXACT REQUIREMENTS:

1. FILE: agents/achiri/memory-store.ts (~80 lines)

2. CLASS AchiriMemoryStore:
   - constructor(storePath: string = 'workspace/achiri/memory/') — creates dir if not exists
   - loadHistory(userId: string): ConversationTurn[] — reads [storePath]/[userId].jsonl, returns array
   - saveHistory(userId: string, history: ConversationTurn[]): void — writes full history to [userId].jsonl
   - appendTurn(userId: string, turn: ConversationTurn): void — appends single turn (efficient)
   - clearHistory(userId: string): void — deletes user history file
   - getStats(): { users: number; total_turns: number } — for dashboard

3. JSONL format: one JSON object per line, each is a ConversationTurn

4. MAX_HISTORY_TURNS = 50 — trim oldest turns when exceeded (keep most recent 50)

5. Import ConversationTurn from './index' (already exported)

6. Under 90 lines

tasks.title: Wire memory into AchiriConversationHandler.chat()
tasks.description:
Update agents/achiri/index.ts to load/save history via AchiriMemoryStore when memory_enabled.

EXACT REQUIREMENTS:

1. Import AchiriMemoryStore from './memory-store'

2. AchiriConversationHandler constructor:
   - Add optional userId: string param (default: 'anonymous')
   - Instantiate AchiriMemoryStore if config.memory_enabled === true

3. chat() method:
   - If memory_enabled: load history from store before building messages
   - After getting response: append both user turn and assistant turn to store
   - history param becomes optional override (if provided, use it; else load from store)

4. New method: clearMemory(userId?: string): void — delegates to store.clearHistory()

5. Keep dry_run mode working (skip store I/O in dry_run)

6. Under 175 lines total
